schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
schemes.description: Housing for All scheme providing financial assistance for construction of pucca houses. Subsidy up to Rs. 2.67 lakh for EWS/LIG categories.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Lower interest rates on home loans
schemes.application_process: Apply online through PMAY portal or visit nearest Common Service Center
schemes.description_translated: आवास for All योजना providing financial assistance for construction of pucca houses. Subsidy up to Rs. 2.67 lakh for EWS/LIG categories.

schemes.name: National Social Assistance Programme - Widow Pension
schemes.description: Financial assistance to widows below poverty line. Monthly pension of Rs. 300-500 provided to support livelihood.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer to bank account
schemes.application_process: Apply through local Panchayat or Municipal office
schemes.name_translated: National Social Assistance Programme - विधवा पेंशन
schemes.description_translated: Financial assistance to विधवाs below poverty line. Monthly पेंशन of Rs. 300-500 provided to support livelihood.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description: Monthly pension for senior citizens above 60 years with no regular income source. Rs. 200-500 per month based on age group.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.application_process: Apply at local Panchayat/Municipal office or online through state portal
schemes.name_translated: Indira Gandhi National वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना (IGNOAPS)
schemes.description_translated: Monthly पेंशन for senior citizens above 60 years with no regular income source. Rs. 200-500 per month based on age group.

schemes.name: National Social Assistance Programme - Disability Pension
schemes.description: Financial support for persons with disabilities. Monthly pension for those with 80% or more disability.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
schemes.application_process: Apply through local authorities with disability certificate
schemes.name_translated: National Social Assistance Programme - विकलांगता पेंशन
schemes.description_translated: Financial support for persons with disabilities. Monthly पेंशन for those with 80% or more विकलांगता.

schemes.name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
schemes.description: Provides 100 days of guaranteed wage employment to rural households. Focuses on creating durable assets.

criteria: Adult member willing to do unskilled manual work

schemes.application_process: Apply for job card at local Gram Panchayat
schemes.name_translated: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
schemes.description_translated: Provides 100 days of guaranteed wage employment to rural households. Focuses on creating durable assets.

schemes.name: National Scholarship Portal - Girl Child Scholarship
schemes.description: Scholarships for girl students from economically weaker sections. Covers tuition fees and other expenses.
schemes.application_process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal
schemes.name_translated: National Scholarship Portal - Girl Child Scholarship
schemes.description_translated: Scholarships for girl students from economically weaker sections. Covers tuition fees and other expenses.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.description: Financial inclusion scheme providing zero-balance bank accounts. Includes RuPay debit card and accident insurance.
schemes.application_process: Visit nearest bank branch or banking correspondent
schemes.description_translated: Financial inclusion योजना providing zero-balance bank accounts. Includes RuPay debit card and accident insurance.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.description: Health insurance scheme providing coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year. Cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

criteria: Bottom 40% of population as per SECC database

benefits: Rs. 5 lakh coverage per family per year
schemes.application_process: Check eligibility online and get Ayushman card from nearest CSC
schemes.name_translated: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.description_translated: Health insurance योजना providing coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year. Cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: Income support to farmer families. Rs. 6000 per year in three equal installments through direct benefit transfer.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.application_process: Apply online through PM-KISAN portal or visit nearest CSC
schemes.description_translated: Income support to farmer families. Rs. 6000 per year in three equal installments through direct benefit transfer.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.description: Savings scheme for girl child. High interest rate and tax benefits. Maturity at age 21 or marriage after 18 years.
schemes.application_process: Open account at post office or authorized bank
schemes.description_translated: Savings योजना for girl child. High interest rate and tax लाभ. Maturity at age 21 or marriage after 18 years.
